name: Knee raise
movement: one knee lifted to a right angle and held

phone.placement: Stand the phone up on the floor, leaning on something, two or three metres away, side on to where you will be.

words.hint: Phone standing up, side on to you, whole body in frame.
words.start: Stand the phone up on the floor, then stand side on, tall, and raise one knee.
words.position: Stand side on to the phone, tall, feet together, arms relaxed at your sides.
words.top: One knee up with the thigh level, the lower leg hanging under it, the trunk tall.
howto: Stand tall beside a chair, one hand on it for balance, weight on the leg furthest from the phone.
Raise the other knee until the thigh is level — or as high as is comfortable — the lower leg hanging relaxed under the knee.
Hold at the top for the count. Keep the standing leg straight and the trunk tall; don't lean back.
Lower slowly and put the foot down — the rep counts when you are standing again.
words.cannot: The standing side and the hips staying level: it follows the raised leg nearest the camera and the trunk. Balance is yours.
words.about: Knee raise — standing side on, tall, one knee up: the thigh's height, as its angle from hanging, at least 75° at the top (90 is level); the lower leg hanging within 20° of plumb under the knee once the thigh is up; and the trunk between 8° back and 15° forward of upright. A rep is under way once the thigh passes 45° and counts when it is back under 20° and you are standing. Hold ten seconds, lower slowly.
words.lost: Step into the camera, side on
words.early: Hold it to the end of the count next time
words.safety: Hold something for balance if you need to; the camera does not mind a hand on a chair.
words.easier: A shorter hold; a hand on a wall.
words.harder: A longer hold; an ankle weight; eyes closed.
words.mistakes: Leaning back to lift the knee; the knee not coming up to level; swinging the foot out in front; rocking the trunk or the pelvis.

measurements.label: knee angle
measurements.why: The angle at the raised knee, drawn but not judged: with the thigh level and the foot hanging under it, about 90.

measurements.label: lower leg hanging

settings.label: Lower leg off vertical, at most (degrees)

measurements.why: The lower leg off plumb: 0 with the foot hanging under the knee; − the foot swung out in front, + tucked back. Judged once the thigh is up.

measurements.label: thigh from straight down
measurements.why: 0 standing, 90 thigh level. Judged at the top — level, or as high as is comfortable — and the progress measurement; it also picks the leg being raised.

settings.label: Thigh at the top, at least (90 is level)

measurements.label: trunk upright
measurements.why: The trunk off plumb, + forward: leaning back is the usual way to get the knee higher.

faults.label: Knee low
faults.text: Lift the knee a little higher — thigh level, if comfortable

faults.label: Foot out in front
faults.text: Let the lower leg hang — foot under the knee

faults.label: Foot tucked back
faults.text: Let the foot hang under the knee

settings.label: Thigh angle that counts as raised
